toolchain.description: The `@deltabox/toolchain` settings (every section is opt-in by presence).

repo.description: Repository URL (`package.json` `repository`). For a workspace it also resolves to the workspace path (`repository.directory`).

inherit.description: Inherit the parent project metadata (default true). Set false to keep this project entirely independent of the root config.

ToolchainProjectConfig.description: Project metadata: canonical `package.json` fields and template tokens (shared fields are inherited by workspaces).

changelog.description: The changelog/version workflow (`changelog.yml`) plus the changelog pipeline config (versioning, VS Code settings, commitlint).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainCiConfig.description: GitHub Actions workflows to generate (CI, release, issues, changelog, sync).

steps.description: Extra steps for a job (one group, or per-job groups).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this workflow (default: enabled when present).

WorkflowOptions.description: Per-workflow overrides merged over the generated default.

job.description: Target job id (defaults to the primary/first job).

WorkflowStepsConfig.description: Extra steps to inject into a workflow job.

WorkflowSetting.description: `true`/`false` to enable/disable, an object to override parts of the default, or a raw YAML string written verbatim as the workflow file.

steps.description: Extra steps for a job (one group, or per-job groups).

enabled.description: Enable/disable the changelog workflow and pipeline (default: enabled when present).

commitlint.description: commitlint config; set `false` to disable the Conventional-Commits pipeline.

versioning.description: Automatic version bumping on changelog generation (default `true`).

vscode.description: Write the Conventional-Commits VS Code settings (default true).

ChangelogConfig.description: Changelog workflow + pipeline: versioning, VS Code settings and commitlint.

main.description: Branch glob(s) the CI + release workflows run on, and the release PR base (default `["main"]`).

dev.description: Branch glob(s) the changelog/version workflow runs on. No default: when omitted it reuses `main` (so a single-branch repo needs no `dev`).

dir.description: Directory the generated `commitlint.config.mjs` is written to (default: the project root). The husky hook and CI use `--config` to point at it.

enabled.description: Enable commitlint (default true when the changelog is enabled). Set false to generate changelogs without the Conventional-Commits pipeline.

ChangelogCommitlintConfig.description: commitlint config, output location and allow-lists.

target.description: `uniform` bumps the root and every workspace to one shared version; `root-only` bumps the root only; `individual` bumps each changed workspace independently (default `uniform`).

workspaces.description: Glob patterns selecting the workspaces to version (relative to the root). Defaults to the root `package.json` `workspaces` field; when there is none the root `package.json` is used on its own.

bump.description: Custom bump rules for major/minor/patch/alpha (matchers or callbacks).

allowOverBump.description: Apply a bump once per matching change instead of once per run (default false).

provider.description: Changelog provider (default `default`; `changesets` or a custom id).

ChangelogVersioningTarget.description: Where the changelog version bump is applied.

ChangelogVersioning.description: Automatic version bumping when a changelog entry is generated.

ChangelogWorkflowSetting.description: `true`/`false` to enable/disable, the changelog pipeline config object, or a raw YAML string written verbatim as the changelog workflow file.

commitlint.description: commitlint config; set `false` to disable the Conventional-Commits pipeline.

versioning.description: Automatic version bumping on changelog generation (default `true`).

vscode.description: Write the Conventional-Commits VS Code settings (default true).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainChangelogConfig.description: Manual `toolchain.changelog` pipeline config for `dbx changelog`, the VS Code actions and the API; `ci.changelog` inherits these options.

vscode.description: Add project-scoped VS Code settings: `true`/`false` or `{ overrides, exclude }` (default false; existing keys are kept).

biome.description: Biome formatter options (merged into the generated `biome.json`).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainFmtConfig.description: Formatter configuration: Oxc/Biome configs, editor defaults and source-tool options.

overrides.description: Settings deep-merged over the generated editor defaults.

vscode.description: Add project-scoped VS Code settings: `true`/`false` or `{ overrides, exclude }` (default false; existing keys are kept).

biome.description: Biome linter options (merged into the generated `biome.json`).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainLintConfig.description: Linter configuration: Oxc/Biome configs, editor defaults and ESLint options.

vscode.description: Write the Biome VS Code settings (default true).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainBiomeConfig.description: Biome config generation (for consumers that still want a `biome.json`).

glob.description: Glob(s) for the workspace default tsconfig files. Defaults to matching every `defaultFile` recursively.

exclude.description: Glob(s) to exclude from `glob`. Defaults to the common ignored paths (`node_modules`, `.dbx`, `dist`, `build`, ...).

gitignore.description: Also respect `.gitignore` files (root + nested) when matching `glob` (default true).

rootFile.description: The workspaces tsconfig file name that holds `paths` + `references` (default `tsconfig.workspaces.json`).

defaultFile.description: The workspace default tsconfig file name that the generator expands (default `tsconfig.default.json`).

buildFile.description: The workspace build tsconfig file name (default `tsconfig.build.json`).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainTsconfigConfig.description: Workspace tsconfig generation (path aliases + project references).

sources.description: Extra sources on top of the builtin + registry sources.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

locate.description: A builtin id, local dir, npm scope, git URL or Vite+ id.

registry.description: Custom npm registry URL (default: the project package manager registry).

subdir.description: Subdirectory within the source that holds the template.

online.description: Whether the source needs network access.

ToolchainTemplateSource.description: A template source: builtin, local, npm, git or Vite+.

templates.description: Allow/deny globs for template sources and registries.

providers.description: Allow/deny globs for provider sources and registries.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

allow.description: Allowed host/path globs. When non-empty, only matching sources are used (eg. `*.example.com`, `https://registry.example.com/**`).

packages.description: The default catalog: package name -> version range.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainCatalogsConfig.description: Package catalogs written to the package manager catalog file (`catalog:`).

config.description: Write the managed Vite config (default true). A string sets its file name/path (relative to the project, or absolute).

fmt.description: Oxfmt options; `true` uses the toolchain defaults.

lint.description: Oxlint options; `true` uses the toolchain defaults.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainViteConfig.description: The full Vite+ config; `dbx sync` writes the root `vite.config.ts` from it.

exclude.description: Glob(s) excluded from watching. Defaults to the common ignored paths (`node_modules`, `.dbx`, `dist`, `build`, ...).

gitignore.description: Also respect `.gitignore` files (root + nested) when watching (default true).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

suppress.description: Warning/error id, message substring, or `/regex/` to silence (single value or array).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainLoggerConfig.description: Logging level, colours and prefix for toolchain output.

color.description: Force provider command colours on/off (default: inherit the logger).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

ToolchainProvidersConfig.description: Provider command behaviour (eg. colour for the passthrough commands).

project.description: Project metadata: canonical `package.json` fields and template tokens (inherited by workspaces).

ci.description: GitHub Actions workflows to generate (CI, release, issues, changelog, sync).

changelog.description: Manual changelog pipeline options for `dbx changelog`, the VS Code actions and the API. `ci.changelog` inherits these options.

fmt.description: Formatter configuration: Oxc/Biome options, editor defaults and tools.

lint.description: Linter configuration: Oxc/Biome/ESLint options and editor defaults.

biome.description: Biome config generation (for consumers that still want a `biome.json`).

tsconfig.description: Workspace tsconfig generation (path aliases + project references).

registry.description: Allow/deny host and path globs for template/provider registries.

catalogs.description: Package catalogs written to the package manager catalog file (`catalog:`).

vite.description: The full Vite+ config; `dbx sync` writes the root `vite.config.ts` from it.

logger.description: Logging level, colours and prefix for toolchain output.

providers.description: Provider command behaviour (eg. colour for the passthrough commands).

title: dbx.config
description: The dbx configuration model (the @deltabox/toolchain settings live under `toolchain`).
